question: Should WhatsApp phone-code login be exposed through the generic `ChannelAuthAdapter` login-method contract and `channels login --phone-number`, or should this entrypoint stay WhatsApp-owned?
rationale: The patch adds a public CLI flag and plugin-facing SDK contract for one channel-specific login method, which is a product/API boundary decision separate from the mechanical Baileys fix.

options.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Fix
options.body: Keep the typed `loginMethod` contract and `--phone-number` flag, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix and live proof before merge.

options.title: Move To WhatsApp-Owned Surface
options.body: Rework the CLI/API so phone-code login is owned by the WhatsApp plugin without expanding the generic channel-auth contract.

options.title: Pause For Upstream Baileys
options.body: Wait for the upstream Baileys pairing-code hardening to land or vendor an equivalent patch before exposing the feature.

recommendation.title: Accept Generic Login Method After Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the typed `loginMethod` contract and `--phone-number` flag, but require the Baileys pairing-code fix and live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses public CLI, plugin SDK, docs, and channel-auth boundaries where recent history points to steipete as the best routing owner.
